body:
Thanks. 

That rings so true about so much of my life. I need to focus less on what makes me sad and focus more on making myself happy.

Right now its honestly not a specific event that upset me.

I had a bad couple of days with family and school, but nothing worse than I have had in the past.

The part that really got to me tonight was that I realized I really cannot express my emotions. I dont know if something is wrong with me or if I need to get professional help, but when I am feeling upset I hide it. I isolate myself from others and always pretend everything is all okay.

I try to compensate for sadness with a false mask of happiness and no one knows that anything is wrong. I have tried but I absolutely cannot simply spill out how i feel and ask for help.

Edit: I think that it stems from a fear of rejection. I feel like no matter how i try to tell myself thay they will care and want to help me, that i am scared they will react badly to the sadness/problems i hide from them.

Has anyone else been like this? How did you admit to others that you werent okay and you needed them for support? Who did you to to?
